facts.fact: Oliver 人生第一次 Easter egg hunt——Eden 一句无心的默认戳中他家的空白。
facts.anchor: Oh, don’t tell me you’ve never had an Easter egg hunt before!

facts.fact: 猎蛋规则：每家成员配 buddy 与区域、彩蛋按色码均分防作弊，限时半小时。
facts.anchor: They’re all colour-coded, and an equal amount to make sure it’s fair and that no-one cheats.

facts.fact: Mark 掏出发令枪开赛——Miller 家的仪式感全部真枪实弹。
facts.anchor: On your marks! Get set! Go!

facts.fact: Eden 的猎蛋打法「不择手段」：朝 Jake 投掷椅子、枕头、衣帽架——Oliver 见证她的暴力与美丽。
facts.anchor: Including throwing a chair at her brother. And a pillow. And the coat stand.

facts.fact: 悲伤测试：想「妈妈若在会多开心」时，胸口惯常的疼这次没有来——「Weird」。
facts.anchor: I know if Mum was here, she’d be loving every second.

facts.fact: 金蛋规则：Dad 藏的纯金蛋值十颗彩蛋，堪称「家传」——藏在檐槽里被 Eden 摸出。
facts.anchor: This little baby is worth ten eggs. Dad hides it.

facts.fact: 正式二吻：金蛋得手后的 gazebo 台阶上，Oliver 主动深吻（ nibble 上唇）——被发令枪再次打断。
facts.anchor: I claim her mouth with my own

facts.fact: 计数仪式：Jake 85 vs 我们 84——反复清点后靠金蛋翻盘终结 Jake 三连胜。
facts.anchor: It’s a tense few minutes as Mark counts and recounts our eggs.

facts.fact: Jake 早知道姓氏 James 的原因：Eden 在家从来停不下嘴地提他。
facts.anchor: Maybe it’s the fact that she never shuts up about you.

facts.fact: 套圈奖品自选：一只背着熟虾的巨大怪猫——Eden 拍板命名「Greg」。
facts.anchor: Laughing, I point at the obnoxiously large cat with a shelled prawn on its back.

facts.fact: 碰碰车场的黑发蓝眼女孩现身——Eden 危险一笑点名「Kiara」：她知道 Jake 的星星夜对象。
